# Slideaboo site

> The public website for Slideaboo, a calm sliding-picture puzzle app for toddlers and the grown-up beside them, on iPhone, iPad and Android. It holds the app's privacy policy, its contact and support page and a philosophy page, each in English and Italian. Static HTML and CSS served by GitHub Pages, with no scripts, forms, cookies or analytics. MIT licensed.

Key facts:

- Live site: https://caputodavide93.github.io/slideaboo-site/
- Privacy policy: https://caputodavide93.github.io/slideaboo-site/privacy/ (Italian: https://caputodavide93.github.io/slideaboo-site/it/privacy/)
- What the privacy policy says about the app: no account, no internet connection, no analytics, ads or tracking, no AI, no permissions. The app keeps the grown-ups' settings and an optional child's first name on the device only. Nothing to buy: no purchases, subscriptions or ads.
- Read the policy itself for the exact wording and its effective date; this summary is not a substitute. Statements about the shipped app come from the policy and are not independently verified here.
- Contact and support page: https://caputodavide93.github.io/slideaboo-site/contact/ (the support address is on that page).
- Philosophy page: https://caputodavide93.github.io/slideaboo-site/philosophy/, the app's own "Why" screen.
- Languages: English and Italian, linked to each other with hreflang.
- Built from plain files: one index.html per page, one shared stylesheet with light and dark colours. No build step.
- Tested: layout and screenshots in Chromium on macOS, light and dark. Safari, Firefox and screen readers are unverified.
- Preview and check locally: `make serve`, then `make check` (needs Python 3).
- Trade-off: only English and Italian exist, and GitHub Pages may keep standard server logs.
- Independent project by Davide Caputo.
